instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief: BeamEcho Field Query Log controls the submission, routing, response, and closure of field questions raised from unclear drawing details. Trade Supervisors submit questions with an affected work area and description; Site Engineers review them, add site observations, and route them to Design Coordinators; Design Coordinators record responses and work-proceed decisions; Document Controllers link final responses to drawing records before questions can be closed. The coordinator-selection method is unresolved, and the tool does not replace drawing revision control.

output.summary: BeamEcho Field Query Log controls field questions raised from unclear drawing details through submission, routing, response, and closure. Trade Supervisors, Site Engineers, Design Coordinators, and Document Controllers participate in the workflow, including linking final responses to drawing records before closure. The coordinator-selection method remains unresolved, and drawing revision control is not replaced.
output.primary_goal: Control the submission, routing, response, and closure of field questions raised from unclear drawing details.

instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Kickoff record: BeamEcho Field Query Log is intended to control the submission, routing, response, and closure of field questions raised from unclear drawing details. A Trade Supervisor submits a field question with the affected work area and a description. A Site Engineer reviews the question, adds site observations, and routes it to the relevant Design Coordinator. A Design Coordinator records the response and identifies whether the affected work may proceed or must remain paused. A Document Controller links the final response to the related drawing record, and closure is blocked until that link exists. The relevant Design Coordinator selection method is unknown. Replacing drawing revision control is outside the project.

output.business_objective: Control the submission, routing, response, and closure of field questions raised from unclear drawing details.
